title: fix(platform-objects): zh-CN organization logo label reads 徽标, not the slug-like 标识
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8Km4RxN1TuQYd4JWCoys2D)_

Fixes #25629

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim of record: `6413940520` on the card (card thread, `domain:server` seat 2). Branch `claude/project-thread-j7jeqt` is the harness-pinned branch for this session. It names no issue, so the claim is the identity record.

## What changed

- zh-CN `sys_organization.fields.logo.label`: 「标识」 → 「徽标」. 「标识」 ("identifier") sat directly beside the slug's 「标识符」 on the organization record page.
- One `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

## Where the fix lives, measured

- There is no upstream source for a translated leaf. `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` uses each locale's committed bundle (`zh-CN.ts`, which pins `objects` to `zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`) as the merge baseline. `os i18n extract --fill=default` keeps any non-empty leaf in a non-default locale (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`, the `mergeExisting` branch). The generated file's own header says "Edit translations in place … only the leaf string values", and the source-hashes companion says "Re-translate the leaf in `LOCALE.objects.generated.ts`".
- So the leaf value was re-translated in place, then the bundles were regenerated with `pnpm i18n:extract`. The regeneration round-trips it: the PR diff is that one leaf, and no other bundle byte moved (11 files rewritten, 1 changed). `pnpm check:i18n` is green on this head: `check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`. The zh-CN source-hashes companion has no entry for this path (a legacy-trusted leaf), so it does not change.

## The rename dialog reads the field label

`rename_organization` and `update_organization` declare `{ field: 'logo', defaultFromRow: true }` with no `label` of their own, and the bundle has no per-param key for them. `ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts` resolves a field-backed param with no authored label as `ctx.fieldLabel(ownerName, param.field, field.label)`, the field's translated label. The dialog's logo param therefore reads 「徽标」.

## Other locales

- ja-JP: logo 「ロゴ」, slug 「スラッグ」. No collision, unchanged.
- es-ES: logo 「Logotipo」, slug 「Slug」. No collision, unchanged.
- No other bundle in the tree labels a logo field 「标识」 (`git grep` over every translation bundle).

## Verification (head `ad0c80bad`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 96 passed, Tests 1361 passed. `typecheck` exit 0 (both under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm check:i18n` exit 0, before and after the change.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 61 derived, 60 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, needs a full build; CI Build Core covers it). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` was first exit 3 on the shallow clone and exit 0 after fetching its control commit.
- Root `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed file exit 0. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0.
- No test pins the old label. No new test: this is copy, and nothing parses it.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch order asked for the fix "at the source the generated bundle is built from" and no hand edit of the generated file. For a translated leaf, that source is the leaf in the generated file itself (above). The change was made through that route and proved by regeneration, not by editing structure.
